column5: Now watch closely. / Some evolution happens through / interaction between TRAINERS. / Will you trade your ancient / POKéMON for my GRAVELER?
RELICANTH will be / sent to BROCK.
Congratulations! Your GRAVELER / evolved into GOLEM!こ /
There it is... / GOLEM. / That’s trade evolution. / A change brought about by / exchange between TRAINERS.
GOLEM is proof that evolution / can be shaped by connection. / Remember that as you continue / OAK’s research.
Ready to trade GYARADOS? / Some POKéMON evolve when traded / while holding something natural. / My POLIWHIRL is holding a / KING’S ROCK. / Will you trade GYARADOS / for my POLIWHIRL?
GYARADOS will be / sent to MISTY.
Congratulations! Your POLIWHIRL / evolved into POLITOED!こ /
There it is... / POLITOED! / A POLIWHIRL traded with a / KING’S ROCK can change into / something completely new.
POLITOED is proof that evolution / can follow the flow of an item / and a trade. / Keep watching how beautifully / POKéMON can change.
Hey, kid! / You’ve got a RAICHU with real / voltage, right? / I’ve got an ELECTABUZZ holding / an ELECTIRIZER. / Trade me your RAICHU for it?
That’s not RAICHU, kid! / Bring me the real lightning rod.

Thank you for coming. / Your challenge in VIRIDIAN FOREST / was witnessed and official. / That forest reminded me that / growth comes through friendship. / Some POKéMON even evolve when / that friendship is allowed to / flourish. / When people and POKéMON support / one another, all may bloom. / You have already earned the / RAINBOWBADGE. / Now, please accept a POKéMON / that shows how friendship can / help life bloom.
Please also accept this BUDEW. / Raise it with kindness, and one / day friendship may help it bloom.
Do you want to give a nickname to / this BUDEW?
BUDEW evolves through friendship / during the day. / Care for it well, and it will show / you how trust becomes growth.
Raise BUDEW with kindness during / the day. / When ROSELIA is recorded in your / POKéDEX, our lesson will bloom.
SABRINA: Your calm presence / earned this CHINGLING’s trust. / I would like you to take it / with you on your journey.
Do you want to give a nickname to / this CHINGLING?
CHINGLING already feels close / to you. Nurture that friendship. / When its bond is strong enough, / it can evolve into CHIMECHO / by leveling up at night.
POKéMON TOWER’s astral pressure / has settled. / The MARSHBADGE is proof that your / mind held firm within it.
KOGA: Fwahahaha! / The LAVIC STONE is secure, and / your challenge was witnessed. / You earned the SOULBADGE in / CINNABAR VOLCANO. / Accept another tool of / togetherness.
Take this GOLBAT as well. / It has trained beside my clan and / understands the strength of trust.
Do you want to give a nickname to / this GOLBAT?
GOLBAT evolves through friendship. / Move with it as one, and it may / become a CROBAT.
Train beside GOLBAT and earn / its trust. / When CROBAT is recorded in your / POKéDEX, the lesson is complete.
